name: compare_database_schema
description:
Compare one database's SQL schema on a branch to another. `database_name` is required. Omit `base_branch_id` to compare against the parent; it is a branch id (`br-...`), not a name. Pass `lsn`, `timestamp`, `base_lsn`, or `base_timestamp` only for a point-in-time comparison.

branch_id is a branch id (br-...), not a branch name. Call list_branches to resolve a name.

project_id.description: Required for an unscoped connection. May be omitted when the connection is scoped to one project; if provided, it must match that project.
